T.label: Primary Tumor (Ovary / Fallopian Tube / Primary Peritoneal, with FIGO equivalents)

categories.description: Primary tumor cannot be assessed
No evidence of primary tumor
Tumor limited to ovaries (one or both) or fallopian tube(s) (FIGO I)
Tumor limited to one ovary (capsule intact) or fallopian tube; no tumor on ovarian or fallopian tube surface; no malignant cells in ascites or peritoneal washings (FIGO IA)
Tumor limited to both ovaries (capsules intact) or fallopian tubes; no tumor on surface; no malignant cells in ascites or peritoneal washings (FIGO IB)
Tumor limited to one or both ovaries or fallopian tubes, with any of: surgical spill; capsule rupture before surgery or surface tumor; malignant ascites/washings (FIGO IC)
Surgical spill (FIGO IC1)
Capsule ruptured before surgery or tumor on ovarian or fallopian tube surface (FIGO IC2)
Malignant cells in ascites or peritoneal washings (FIGO IC3)
Tumor involves one or both ovaries or fallopian tubes with pelvic extension below pelvic brim, or primary peritoneal cancer (FIGO II)
Extension and/or implants on uterus and/or fallopian tube(s) and/or ovaries (FIGO IIA)
Extension to and/or implants on other pelvic tissues (FIGO IIB)

Tumor involves one or both ovaries or fallopian tubes, or primary peritoneal cancer, with microscopically confirmed peritoneal metastasis outside pelvis and/or retroperitoneal (pelvic/para-aortic) lymph node metastasis (FIGO III)
Microscopic extrapelvic (above pelvic brim) peritoneal involvement with or without positive retroperitoneal lymph nodes (FIGO IIIA2)
Macroscopic peritoneal metastasis beyond pelvis ≤ 2 cm in greatest dimension with or without retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis (FIGO IIIB)

Macroscopic peritoneal metastasis beyond pelvis > 2 cm in greatest dimension with or without retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis (includes extension of tumor to capsule of liver and spleen without parenchymal involvement) (FIGO IIIC)
Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed
No regional lymph node metastasis
Isolated tumor cells in regional lymph node(s) ≤ 0.2 mm
Positive retroperitoneal lymph nodes only (histologically confirmed) (FIGO IIIA1)
Metastasis ≤ 10 mm in greatest dimension (FIGO IIIA1i)
Metastasis > 10 mm in greatest dimension (FIGO IIIA1ii)
No distant metastasis
Distant metastasis (parent for M1a/M1b)
Pleural effusion with positive cytology (FIGO IVA)
Liver or splenic parenchymal metastases; extra-abdominal metastases (including inguinal lymph nodes and lymph nodes outside abdominal cavity); transmural involvement of intestine (FIGO IVB)
Clinical classification.
Pathological classification.
Post-neoadjuvant.
No neoadjuvant therapy.
